# stb

`stb_image.h` (v2.30) and `stb_image_write.h` (v1.16), by Sean Barrett and contributors, from https://github.com/nothings/stb. They are public domain, or MIT at your choice; the licence text is at the end of each file.

They are used only by the command-line tool (`tools/cli/image_io.cpp`) to read image files and write PNGs. The core library does not depend on them.
